title: G0 Rapid Move
text:
G0 Rapid Move

For rapid linear motion program G0 axes. The tool moves at the maximum rapid rate to the end point.

title: G1 Linear Move
text:
G1 Linear Move

For linear straight line motion at programmed feed rate F program G01 axes.

title: G2, G3 Arc Move
text:
G2, G3 Arc Move

A circular or helical arc is specified using G2 clockwise arc or G3 counterclockwise arc. Center offsets I J K or radius R.

title: G4 Dwell
text:
G4 Dwell

G4 P- dwell. The P number is the time in seconds that all axes will remain unmoving, a pause.

title: M3, M4, M5 Spindle Control
text:
M3, M4, M5 Spindle Control

M3 start the spindle clockwise at the S speed. M4 counterclockwise. M5 stop the spindle.

title: M2, M30 Program End
text:
M2, M30 Program End

To end a program program M2 or M30. M30 also exchanges pallet shuttles and rewinds the program to the start.

title: M6 Tool Change
text:
M6 Tool Change

M6 performs a tool change using the tool selected with the T word.

title: G38.n Straight Probe
text:
G38.n Straight Probe

G38.2 probe toward workpiece, stop on contact, signal error if failure.
